lines.speaker: Super Buu
lines.text: Oh good, another fusion. So what are you then?

lines.speaker: Vegito
lines.text: We are a warrior born of the Potara — a combination of Vegeta and Go—

lines.speaker: Vegito
lines.text: Huh, that was weird. Why can't we say Go—? Go—!

lines.speaker: Super Buu
lines.text: Are you... two? Are you alright?

lines.speaker: Vegito
lines.text: Sir, we are talking to ourselves.

lines.speaker: Vegito
lines.text: Whatever! You can just call us Vegito.

lines.speaker: Vegito
lines.text: Sir, we will fight you in a minute.
